adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. This contradicts the variable name and typical permission logic (admin OR owner). As written, a non-owner team admin will fail the check and be blocked by `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)`, wrongly denying access to add guests.
